EmailTemplate.subject: Happy Holidays from Flywire! Are you interested in a demo?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=there}},
Happy Holidays from Flywire! As 2022 winds down, I know many of our travel clients are preparing for 2023. If you are doing the same, I'd love to grab a few minutes of your time to discuss how Flywire can help make next year even more successful for {{company.Company Name:default=your company}}.
You can see an overview of our benefits here <[[https://assets.flywire.com/collateral/travel/clients/Flywire_Travel_Overview.pdf?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, but put simply - Flywire lets your guests pay in 120+ currencies via card, bank transfer, Paypal, etc. - and can save your business 1%+ on your international transactions.
Do you have some time to connect this week?
Thanks,
Anne-Sophie
Anne-Sophie Kadjo Business Development Representative
